vulnerable_test: test_M01_attacker_precreate_low_fee_is_adopted -> PASS: migratedPair == attacker pre-created pair; adopted swap fee 1 bps vs intended 100 bps
measurable_impact: protocol/agent LPs earn 1 bps instead of the intended 100 bps swap fee on the migrated pool (~99% lost fee revenue), for the life of the pool; attacker also controls the adopted pool's initial price/reserves.
